title: 30-day returns
body: Northline accepts returns within 30 days of delivery when the item is unworn and the customer provides an order number. Refunds go back to the original payment method.

title: Damaged item replacement
body: If a Northline item arrives damaged, send a photo of the damage and the order number. Northline ships a replacement or issues a refund and waives the return shipping fee.

title: Shipping speed
body: Standard Northline shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Expedited shipping takes 2 business days. Shipping time starts the day after the order leaves the warehouse.

title: Tracking an order
body: A Northline tracking link is sent in the shipment email and is also listed on the account orders page once the carrier scans the package.

title: Canceling an order
body: A Northline order can be canceled only while its status is still Processing. After the status changes to Shipped, the customer uses the return process instead of cancellation.

title: Changing a shipping address
body: Northline can change a shipping address only before the warehouse marks the order Shipped. After that, the carrier must be contacted with the tracking number.

title: Statement charge name
body: A pending Northline card charge may appear as NORTHLINE*OUTFITTERS. The pending hold drops off after the order ships and the final charge posts.

title: Refund timing
body: After the warehouse receives a Northline return, the refund posts to the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days.

title: Gear warranty
body: Northline packs have a lifetime warranty on seams. Headlamps and other electronics have a 1-year warranty. Warranty claims need the order number and a short description of the failure.

title: Password reset
body: Northline password reset links are sent from the sign-in page and expire after 30 minutes. Each new request invalidates the previous link.

title: Store hours
body: Northline stores are open from 10am to 7pm local time. Stores are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

title: Gift cards
body: Northline gift cards do not expire. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash and cannot be used to buy another gift card.

title: Size exchange
body: Northline offers one free size exchange per item within 30 days of delivery. The replacement ships after the original size is scanned back at the warehouse.

title: Where Northline ships
body: Northline ships online orders only to addresses in the United States and Canada. It does not ship to other international addresses.

title: Promo codes
body: A Northline order accepts one promo code. Promo codes cannot be combined with items already marked as a sale price.

title: Washing a down jacket
body: Wash a Northline down jacket cold on the gentle cycle and tumble dry on low heat with clean tennis balls so the down refluffs.

title: Drying leather boots
body: Dry Northline leather boots at room temperature. Do not put them on a radiator. Condition the leather twice a season.

title: Trail membership shipping
body: Northline Trail members receive free standard shipping on orders over $50. Expedited shipping is still charged.

title: Account data
body: Northline uses account data to fulfill orders and answer support requests. Customers can delete an account in settings. Northline does not sell personal information.

title: Wholesale inquiries
body: Northline wholesale requests, including retailer accounts and bulk pricing, go to wholesale@northline.example. Retail order support cannot open a wholesale account.
